'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
***[[War crimes in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[Attacks on civilians in the 2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
*****[[Russian attack on civilian convoy in Zaporizhzhia]]
******[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] launch 16 missiles at areas near the city of [[Zaporizhzhia]], including a gathering point for [[civilian]]s preparing to cross into [[Russian occupation of Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Russian-occupied territory]], where at least 25 people are killed and 50 others are injured. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/russian-missile-strike-civilian-convoy-ukraine-zaporizhzhia-rcna50132 (NBC News)]
***[[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] requests fast-track [[NATO]] membership following the [[Russian annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-63077272 (BBC News)]
***[[2022 Russian mobilization]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] says that it will not [[deport]] [[Russians]] fleeing [[conscription]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/uzbekistan-says-wont-deport-russians-fleeing-conscription-2022-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[September 2022 Kabul school bombing]]
***Twenty-six people are killed and 56 others are injured by a [[Suicide bombing|suicide bomber]] at a school in [[Dashte Barchi]], [[Kabul]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2022/09/30/asia/kabul-explosion-education-center-intl-hnk/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Papua conflict]]
**Four people are killed when armed rebels open fire on civilians in [[West Papua (province)|West Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/four-shot-dead-indonesias-restive-papua-region-police-2022-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*[[September 2022 Burkina Faso coup d'état]]
**Junta leader [[Paul-Henri Sandaogo Damiba]] is removed from office in a [[coup d'état]] after gunfire in the [[Burkina Faso|Burkinabé]] capital of [[Ouagadougou]]. Coup leader [[Ibrahim Traoré]] imposes a curfew, suspends all political civil society activities as well as the Constitution, and closes all land and air borders. [https://apnews.com/article/united-nations-general-assembly-ouagadougou-africa-west-e50ee2eb815152a594a2b441304f4868 (AP)] [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20220930-shots-fired-near-burkina-faso-s-presidential-palace-in-ouagadougou (France24)]
*[[Mahsa Amini protests]]
**Nineteen people are killed and 32 more injured when three gunmen attack a police station and [[mass shooting|open fire]] in a [[mass shooting]] in [[Zahedan]], [[Iran]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/1/19-killed-including-four-elite-guard-members-in-iran-attack (Al Jazeera)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]], [[Economy of the Netherlands]]
**[[Inflation]] in the [[Netherlands]] increases to 17% amid a substantial increase in energy and fuel prices. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/europe/dutch-inflation-leaps-17-boosted-by-high-energy-prices-2022-09-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**[[Hurricane Ian]] makes its fourth landfall in [[South Carolina]], after devastating portions of [[Florida]] and [[Cuba]]. [https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/archive/2022/al09/al092022.update.09301814.shtml (National Hurricane Center)]
*Two people are killed and 25 others are injured by a 5.9 magnitude [[earthquake]] in [[North Sumatra|Northern Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/earthquake-magnitude-57-strikes-northern-sumatra-indonesia-emsc-2022-09-30/ (Reuters)]
*Eight people are killed and three others are missing after flooding in [[Táchira]], [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/flooding-western-venezuela-kills-least-eight-2022-09-30/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Foreign relations of Nicaragua]]
**The Nicaraguan government announced that it had severed diplomatic relations with the Netherlands.

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Russian annexation of Southern and Eastern Ukraine]]
**Russian president [[Vladimir Putin]] signs accession treaties to annex the [[Occupied territories of Ukraine|occupied Ukrainian territories]] to Russia. However, the accession treaties must be ratified by both houses of the [[Russian parliament]] before becoming effective under [[Russian law]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/putin-declare-annexation-ukrainian-lands-major-escalation-war-2022-09-29/ (Reuters)] [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/factbox-russias-annexation-plan-in-ukraine-kremlin-signing-ceremony/ar-AA12nYnk (Reuters 2)]
*Mexican president [[Andrés Manuel López Obrador]] confirms that the Mexican [[Secretariat of National Defense]] was hacked and that leaked data included information about the president's health issues and other [[national security]] issues. [https://www.proceso.com.mx/nacional/2022/9/30/amlo-admite-hackeo-de-grupo-guacamaya-la-sedena-que-esta-enfermo-294305.html (Proceso)]
